title: Indexed clopen decompositions of a scheme
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be any set, and let $(P_e)_{e\in E}$ be a family of open subschemes of $W$. The family is an $E$-indexed clopen decomposition of $W$ if $P_e\cap P_{e\prime}=\varnothing$ whenever $e\ne e\prime$ and $\bigcup_{e\in E}P_e=W$. Each piece is closed as well as open, since its complement is the union of the other pieces. Empty pieces, an empty scheme, and an empty indexing set are allowed.
